parsedVerdict.reasoning: The module has one concern: regional market cluster risk rules. All five rule classes extend Rule<Settings> and share the Settings interface, so the files are cohesive and use the module's abstractions consistently. The problem is duplication. The same threshold-band invariant is copied in full into five files. Each copy computes the region ratio with the same divide-by-zero guard, checks it against thresholdMax and thresholdMin, and formats the results as percentages with toPrecision(3). getConfiguration is also identical in every file (max 1, min 0, step 0.01, unit '%'), and so is the getSettings logic. The only real differences are the region key/translation id, the region value field, and the default thresholds. Any change to the evaluation logic, number formatting or configuration bounds must be made in five places. That fails the rubric's requirement to keep each rule or invariant in one place.
